title: Perfumery Workshop
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Unlike store-bought perfumes, your creation will be uniquely yours, made from a selection of clean, essential oil-infused scents. Guided by experts, you'll learn the secrets of fragrance composition, blending top, heart, and base notes to design a signature scent that reflects your personality.

What sets us apart? We focus on toxin-free, sustainable ingredients and provide a relaxed, interactive setting where creativity flourishes. Enjoy complimentary drinks and snacks as you design your custom perfume, which you’ll bottle and take home as a lasting memory of this special experience. Perfect for individuals, couples, or groups, this workshop is fun, educational, and unforgettable. Book now and create something truly unique!
